items.html: Indeed you must know that when this dross was sorted, and from it were made their own four worlds ABYA — and they are dross and complete shells — there were placed within them all those parts of the kings that could not be sorted, and they were there as the Neshama and the vitality within them, which gives them life, as mentioned in Parashat Yitro, p. 69a: “There is no Sitra Achra [other side] in which there is not a thin illumination,” etc. And this is the secret of the pursuit by the evil inclination and the Sitra Achra to make the righteous sin and to cling to holiness, since they have no vitality apart from it, and as the good and the holiness increase, their life increases. And from now on do not wonder why the evil inclination pursues to make man sin. And understand this.
